summary: The main article describes a regioselective trifluoromethoxylation of pyridines and pyrimidines using Togni reagent I. It includes optimization tables, substrate scope for various heterocycles, and mechanistic studies involving radical intermediates and nitrenium ions.

items.heading: Fig. 1
items.description: Properties, applications, and synthetic challenges of trifluoromethoxy-containing compounds, including structural orientation and metabolic stability.

items.heading: Table 1
items.description: Optimization of reaction conditions for the trifluoromethoxylation of a pyridine substrate, screening various reagents, bases, and solvents.

items.heading: Table 2
items.description: Substrate scope for the trifluoromethoxylation of various functionalized pyridines, showing yields and regioselectivity.

items.heading: Table 3
items.description: Substrate scope for the trifluoromethoxylation of various pyrimidines.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.description: Gram-scale synthesis of a trifluoromethoxylated pyridine and subsequent post-functionalization via cross-coupling and amidation reactions.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.description: Mechanistic studies including radical inhibition experiments and the proposed reaction pathway involving a nitrenium ion intermediate.
